panels.visual: Herodes Atticus (Greek, curly beard, fine robes, rings) in a rich villa surrounded by gold, about AD 160
panels.caption: Around AD 160 the richest man in Greece was an Athenian called Herodes Atticus.

panels.visual: His father kneeling in the family house beside a broken floor, staring at a buried pot overflowing with gold coins
panels.caption: The family fortune began, they said, when his father found buried treasure in their house.

panels.visual: Herodes marrying Regilla, a rich Roman noblewoman
panels.caption: He married Regilla, a rich Roman lady.

panels.visual: A freedman in a tunic lashing out with a kick at Regilla, who is expecting a baby; shown from behind, no injuries
panels.caption: When she was expecting a baby, one of his freedmen kicked her in the stomach, and she died.

panels.visual: Regilla's brother pointing furiously at Herodes in a Roman law court
panels.caption: Her brother accused Herodes of ordering it.

panels.visual: Herodes on trial in Rome before the emperor on a high seat; then walking free
panels.caption: He was tried in Rome, and let off.

panels.visual: Herodes in black mourning clothes showing builders a plan for a great music hall
panels.caption: Herodes said he was heartbroken. He built this music hall in Regilla's memory.

panels.visual: The finished Odeon with a cedar-wood roof, musicians on stage and about five thousand people on the curved seats
panels.caption: It held about five thousand people, under a roof of cedar wood.

panels.visual: AD 267: raiders burning Athens, the Odeon's wooden roof in flames
panels.caption: About a hundred years later, raiders burnt Athens. The roof went up in flames.

panels.visual: The roofless ruin covered in weeds under the Acropolis for centuries
panels.caption: For centuries it stood as a ruin.

panels.visual: Today: the rebuilt marble seats full of people at a summer night concert, lights on the stage
panels.caption: In the 1950s the seats were rebuilt in marble. Today it is full of concerts again on summer nights.

panels.visual: Glauka the owl counting the rows of round arches in the tall stone wall
panels.caption: Count the rows of round arches in the big wall: a Roman idea.
